name: adhesion G protein-coupled receptor G1
pathways: positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction

function.text: ADGRG1 encodes adhesion G protein-coupled receptor G1 [Cleaved into: Adhesion G protein-coupled receptor G1, N-terminal fragment); Adhesion G protein-coupled receptor G1, C-terminal fragment)]. Annotated molecular activities include G protein-coupled receptor activity and collagen binding. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to bilateral frontoparietal polymicrogyria (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
